args:
import subprocess, sys, os
os.chdir('/tmp')
script = r'''cd "/tmp" && sort -V -t'|' -k1 srt_lines.txt > srt_sorted.txt && i=1; start=0; > full.srt; while IFS='|' read -r idx dur text; do dur=${dur:-8}; end=$(awk "BEGIN{print $start+$dur}"); sh=$(awk "BEGIN{printf \"%02d:%02d:%06.3f\",int($start/3600),int($start%3600/60),$start%60}"); eh=$(awk "BEGIN{printf \"%02d:%02d:%06.3f\",int($end/3600),int($end%3600/60),$end%60}"); printf '%d\n%s --> %s\n%s\n\n' "$i" "$(echo $sh|sed 's/\./,/')" "$(echo $eh|sed 's/\./,/')" "$text" >> full.srt; start=$end; i=$((i+1)); done < srt_sorted.txt && rm -f srt_sorted.txt && echo SRT_BUILT && cat full.srt'''
r = subprocess.run(script, shell=True, executable='/bin/bash')
sys.exit(r.returncode)

import subprocess, sys, os
os.chdir('/tmp')
script = r'''F=/tmp/final.mp4; test -s "$F" || { echo FINAL_MISSING; exit 1; }; ffprobe -v error -select_streams v:0 -show_entries stream=codec_name -of csv=p=0 "$F" | grep -qi h264 || { echo FINAL_NO_VIDEO; exit 1; }; repair_audio(){ ls /tmp/scene_*.mp3 >/dev/null 2>&1 || return 1; ls /tmp/scene_*.mp3 | sort -V | sed "s/^/file '/;s/$/'/" > /tmp/audio_concat.txt; ffmpeg -y -threads 1 -f concat -safe 0 -i /tmp/audio_concat.txt -c:a aac -b:a 128k -ar 44100 -ac 1 /tmp/repaired_audio.m4a 2>/dev/null; [ -s /tmp/repaired_audio.m4a ] || return 1; ffmpeg -y -threads 1 -i "$F" -i /tmp/repaired_audio.m4a -map 0:v -map 1:a -c:v copy -c:a copy -shortest /tmp/final_repaired.mp4 2>/dev/null; [ -s /tmp/final_repaired.mp4 ] || return 1; mv -f /tmp/final_repaired.mp4 "$F"; rm -f /tmp/repaired_audio.m4a /tmp/audio_concat.txt; return 0; }; HAS_A=$(ffprobe -v error -select_streams a:0 -show_entries stream=codec_name -of csv=p=0 "$F" 2>/dev/null); if ! echo "$HAS_A" | grep -qi aac; then echo FINAL_NO_AUDIO_ATTEMPTING_REPAIR; if repair_audio; then echo FINAL_AUDIO_REPAIRED; else echo FINAL_AUDIO_MISSING_UNRECOVERABLE; exit 1; fi; fi; MAXVOL=$(ffmpeg -i "$F" -af volumedetect -f null - 2>&1 | grep -o 'max_volume: [-0-9.]*' | awk '{print $2}'); MAXVOL=${MAXVOL:--99}; ISSILENT=$(awk "BEGIN{print ($MAXVOL<=-50)?1:0}"); if [ "$ISSILENT" = "1" ]; then echo FINAL_AUDIO_SILENT_${MAXVOL}dB_ATTEMPTING_REPAIR; if repair_audio; then MAXVOL2=$(ffmpeg -i "$F" -af volumedetect -f null - 2>&1 | grep -o 'max_volume: [-0-9.]*' | awk '{print $2}'); MAXVOL2=${MAXVOL2:--99}; STILLSILENT=$(awk "BEGIN{print ($MAXVOL2<=-50)?1:0}"); if [ "$STILLSILENT" = "1" ]; then echo FINAL_AUDIO_STILL_SILENT_AFTER_REPAIR; exit 1; fi; echo FINAL_AUDIO_REPAIRED_${MAXVOL2}dB; else echo FINAL_AUDIO_SILENT_UNRECOVERABLE; exit 1; fi; fi; DUR=$(ffprobe -v error -show_entries format=duration -of csv=p=0 "$F"); DUR=${DUR:-0}; OK=$(awk "BEGIN{print ($DUR>=10 && $DUR<=120)?1:0}"); if [ "$OK" != "1" ]; then echo FINAL_BAD_DUR_$DUR; exit 1; fi; echo FINAL_OK_$DUR'''
r = subprocess.run(script, shell=True, executable='/bin/bash')
sys.exit(r.returncode)

import subprocess, sys, os
os.chdir('/tmp')
script = r'''IMG=/tmp/scene_{{ $node["Prep Scene"].json.idx }}.jpg; NEEDGEN=0; if [ ! -s "$IMG" ]; then echo IMG_MISSING_GEN; NEEDGEN=1; else SZ=$(stat -c%s "$IMG"); if [ "$SZ" -lt 3000 ]; then echo IMG_TOO_SMALL_${SZ}_GEN; NEEDGEN=1; else ffprobe -v error -select_streams v:0 -show_entries stream=width,height -of csv=p=0 "$IMG" >/dev/null 2>&1 || { echo IMG_NOT_VALID_GEN; NEEDGEN=1; }; fi; fi; if [ "$NEEDGEN" = "1" ]; then ffmpeg -y -threads 1 -f lavfi -i color=c=black:s=540x960:d=1 -frames:v 1 "$IMG" 2>/dev/null && echo PLACEHOLDER_MADE; fi; SZ2=$(stat -c%s "$IMG" 2>/dev/null); echo IMG_OK_${SZ2:-0}'''
r = subprocess.run(script, shell=True, executable='/bin/bash')
sys.exit(r.returncode)

import subprocess, sys, os
os.chdir('/tmp')
script = r'''IDX={{ $node["Prep Scene"].json.idx }}; F=/tmp/scene_${IDX}.mp3; makesilent(){ ffmpeg -y -threads 1 -f lavfi -i anullsrc=r=44100:cl=mono -t 6 -c:a libmp3lame -b:a 128k "$F" 2>/dev/null; }; if [ ! -s "$F" ]; then echo VOICE_MISSING_REPAIR; makesilent; fi; DUR=$(ffprobe -v error -show_entries format=duration -of csv=p=0 "$F" 2>/dev/null); DUR=${DUR:-0}; TOOSHORT=$(awk "BEGIN{print ($DUR<1.0)?1:0}"); TOOLONG=$(awk "BEGIN{print ($DUR>15)?1:0}"); if [ "$TOOSHORT" = "1" ]; then echo VOICE_TOO_SHORT_${DUR}_PADDING; ffmpeg -y -threads 1 -i "$F" -af "apad=pad_dur=5" -t 6 -c:a libmp3lame -b:a 128k /tmp/scene_${IDX}_pad.mp3 2>/dev/null && mv -f /tmp/scene_${IDX}_pad.mp3 "$F"; fi; if [ "$TOOLONG" = "1" ]; then echo VOICE_TOO_LONG_${DUR}_TRIM; ffmpeg -y -threads 1 -i "$F" -t 14 -c:a libmp3lame -b:a 128k /tmp/scene_${IDX}_trim.mp3 2>/dev/null && mv -f /tmp/scene_${IDX}_trim.mp3 "$F"; fi; CODEC=$(ffprobe -v error -select_streams a:0 -show_entries stream=codec_name -of csv=p=0 "$F" 2>/dev/null); if [ -z "$CODEC" ]; then echo VOICE_NO_AUDIO_STREAM_REPAIR; makesilent; fi; MAXVOL=$(ffmpeg -i "$F" -af volumedetect -f null - 2>&1 | grep -o 'max_volume: [-0-9.]*' | awk '{print $2}'); MAXVOL=${MAXVOL:--99}; ISSILENT=$(awk "BEGIN{print ($MAXVOL<=-50)?1:0}"); if [ "$ISSILENT" = "1" ]; then echo VOICE_EFFECTIVELY_SILENT_${MAXVOL}dB_REPAIR; makesilent; fi; FDUR=$(ffprobe -v error -show_entries format=duration -of csv=p=0 "$F" 2>/dev/null); FDUR=${FDUR:-0}; OK=$(awk "BEGIN{print ($FDUR>=1.0 && $FDUR<=15)?1:0}"); if [ "$OK" != "1" ]; then echo VOICE_FINAL_REPAIR; makesilent; FDUR=6.0; fi; echo VOICE_OK_$FDUR'''
r = subprocess.run(script, shell=True, executable='/bin/bash')
sys.exit(r.returncode)

import subprocess, sys, os
os.chdir('/tmp')
script = r'''cd "/tmp" && ls clip_*.mp4 | sort -V | sed "s/^/file '/;s/$/'/" > concat.txt && ffmpeg -y -threads 1 -f concat -safe 0 -i concat.txt -c copy /tmp/merged.mp4 && test -s /tmp/merged.mp4 || exit 1; HAS_A=$(ffprobe -v error -select_streams a:0 -show_entries stream=codec_name -of csv=p=0 /tmp/merged.mp4 2>/dev/null); if [ -z "$HAS_A" ]; then echo MERGED_NO_AUDIO_FIX; ffmpeg -y -threads 1 -i /tmp/merged.mp4 -f lavfi -i anullsrc=r=44100:cl=mono -c:v copy -c:a aac -b:a 128k -shortest /tmp/merged2.mp4 2>/dev/null && mv -f /tmp/merged2.mp4 /tmp/merged.mp4; fi; if [ -s /tmp/bgm.mp3 ]; then ffmpeg -y -threads 1 -i /tmp/merged.mp4 -stream_loop -1 -i /tmp/bgm.mp3 -filter_complex "[1:a]volume=0.12[bg];[0:a][bg]amix=inputs=2:duration=first:dropout_transition=2[aout]" -map 0:v -map "[aout]" -c:v copy -c:a aac -b:a 128k -ar 44100 -ac 1 -shortest /tmp/withaudio.mp4 2>/dev/null || cp /tmp/merged.mp4 /tmp/withaudio.mp4; else cp /tmp/merged.mp4 /tmp/withaudio.mp4; fi && rm -f /tmp/clip_*.mp4 /tmp/merged.mp4 && ffmpeg -y -threads 1 -i /tmp/withaudio.mp4 -vf "subtitles=/tmp/full.srt:force_style='FontName=DejaVu Sans,FontSize=15,Bold=1,PrimaryColour=&H00FFFFFF,OutlineColour=&H00000000,BorderStyle=1,Outline=3,Shadow=1,Alignment=2,MarginV=120'" -c:v libx264 -preset ultrafast -crf 30 -x264-params ref=1:bframes=0 -g 40 -c:a copy -pix_fmt yuv420p -r 20 /tmp/final.mp4 2>/tmp/sub_err.log || { echo SUBTITLE_FAILED_FALLBACK; cat /tmp/sub_err.log 2>/dev/null | tail -3; cp /tmp/withaudio.mp4 /tmp/final.mp4; } && rm -f /tmp/withaudio.mp4 /tmp/sub_err.log && test -s /tmp/final.mp4 && ls -lh /tmp/final.mp4 && echo CONCAT_OK'''
r = subprocess.run(script, shell=True, executable='/bin/bash')
sys.exit(r.returncode)

import subprocess, sys, os
os.chdir('/tmp')
script = r'''test -s /tmp/thumb_src.jpg && ffmpeg -y -threads 1 -i /tmp/thumb_src.jpg -vf "scale=1280:720:force_original_aspect_ratio=increase,crop=1280:720" -q:v 4 /tmp/thumb.jpg && rm -f /tmp/thumb_src.jpg /tmp/scene_*.jpg && echo THUMB_OK'''
r = subprocess.run(script, shell=True, executable='/bin/bash')
sys.exit(r.returncode)

args:
import subprocess, sys, os
os.chdir('/tmp')
script = r'''MISSING=""; for i in 1 2 3 4 5; do   if [ ! -s "/tmp/clip_${i}.mp4" ]; then     MISSING="$MISSING $i";   fi; done; N=$(ls /tmp/clip_*.mp4 2>/dev/null | wc -l); echo CLIPS_READY_${N}_OF_5; if [ -n "$MISSING" ]; then   echo MISSING_SCENES:${MISSING};   for i in $MISSING; do     echo --- scene ${i} diagnostics ---;     ls -la /tmp/scene_${i}.jpg /tmp/scene_${i}.mp3 2>&1;     if [ -f /tmp/ffmpeg_err_${i}.log ]; then echo ffmpeg_err_${i}.log:; tail -c 400 /tmp/ffmpeg_err_${i}.log; fi;   done;   echo NOT_ALL_CLIPS_YET; exit 1; fi; echo ALL_CLIPS_OK'''
r = subprocess.run(script, shell=True, executable='/bin/bash')
sys.exit(r.returncode)

import subprocess, sys, os
os.chdir('/tmp')
script = r'''IDX={{ $node["Prep Scene"].json.idx }}; CLIP=/tmp/clip_${IDX}.mp4; if [ -s "$CLIP" ]; then echo CLIP_${IDX}_ALREADY_OK; exit 0; fi; if [ ! -s /tmp/scene_${IDX}.jpg ]; then echo MISSING_IMAGE_${IDX}; exit 1; fi; if [ ! -s /tmp/scene_${IDX}.mp3 ]; then echo MISSING_AUDIO_${IDX}; exit 1; fi; ADUR=$(ffprobe -v error -show_entries format=duration -of csv=p=0 /tmp/scene_${IDX}.mp3 2>/dev/null); ADUR=${ADUR:-8}; CDUR=$(awk "BEGIN{a=$ADUR; p=a+0.6; min=6.0; max=12.0; d=(p>min)?p:min; d=(d<max)?d:max; printf \"%.3f\", d}"); echo ENCODING_${IDX}_DUR_${CDUR}; ffmpeg -y -threads 1 -loop 1 -i /tmp/scene_${IDX}.jpg -i /tmp/scene_${IDX}.mp3 -c:v libx264 -tune stillimage -preset ultrafast -crf 32 -x264-params ref=1:bframes=0 -g 36 -vf "scale=432:768:force_original_aspect_ratio=decrease,pad=432:768:(ow-iw)/2:(oh-ih)/2,setsar=1" -c:a aac -b:a 96k -ar 44100 -ac 1 -pix_fmt yuv420p -r 18 -t $CDUR "$CLIP" 2>/tmp/ffmpeg_err_${IDX}.log; FFRC=$?; if [ "$FFRC" != "0" ] || [ ! -s "$CLIP" ]; then echo FFMPEG_FAILED_${IDX}_RC_${FFRC}; tail -c 400 /tmp/ffmpeg_err_${IDX}.log 2>/dev/null; exit 1; fi; DUR=$(ffprobe -v error -show_entries format=duration -of default=noprint_wrappers=1:nokey=1 "$CLIP"); echo "${IDX}|$DUR|{{ $node["Prep Scene"].json.voiceSrtSafe }}" >> /tmp/srt_lines.txt && cp -f /tmp/scene_1.jpg /tmp/thumb_src.jpg 2>/dev/null; echo CLIP_${IDX}_OK_${DUR}'''
r = subprocess.run(script, shell=True, executable='/bin/bash')
sys.exit(r.returncode)

import subprocess, sys, os
os.chdir('/tmp')
script = r'''IDX={{ $node["Prep Scene"].json.idx }}; OUT=/tmp/scene_${IDX}.mp3; TXTFILE=/tmp/tts_text_${IDX}.txt; rm -f "$OUT"; cat > "$TXTFILE" <<'TTSEOF'
{{ $node["Prep Scene"].json.voiceSrtSafe }}
TTSEOF
WCCHK=$(wc -w < "$TXTFILE" 2>/dev/null); WCCHK=${WCCHK:-0}; if [ "$WCCHK" -lt 1 ]; then echo TEXT_EMPTY_USING_SILENT; ffmpeg -y -threads 1 -f lavfi -i anullsrc=r=44100:cl=mono -t 6 -c:a libmp3lame -b:a 128k "$OUT" 2>/dev/null && echo TTS_SILENT_OK; rm -f "$TXTFILE"; exit 0; fi; validmp3(){ [ -s "$OUT" ] || return 1; head -c1 "$OUT" | grep -q '{' && return 1; CODEC=$(ffprobe -v error -select_streams a:0 -show_entries stream=codec_name -of csv=p=0 "$OUT" 2>/dev/null); [ -n "$CODEC" ] || return 1; D=$(ffprobe -v error -show_entries format=duration -of csv=p=0 "$OUT" 2>/dev/null); D=${D:-0}; awk "BEGIN{exit !($D>=1.0)}" || return 1; MAXVOL=$(ffmpeg -i "$OUT" -af volumedetect -f null - 2>&1 | grep -o 'max_volume: [-0-9.]*' | awk '{print $2}'); MAXVOL=${MAXVOL:--99}; awk "BEGIN{exit !($MAXVOL>-50)}"; }; edge-tts --voice en-US-AndrewNeural --file "$TXTFILE" --write-media "$OUT" 2>/tmp/edge_err_${IDX}.log; if validmp3; then echo TTS_EDGE_OK; else echo EDGE_FAILED_SILENT; cat /tmp/edge_err_${IDX}.log 2>/dev/null; rm -f "$OUT"; WC=$(wc -w < "$TXTFILE"); WC=${WC:-8}; SD=$(awk "BEGIN{d=$WC/2.8; if(d<6)d=6; if(d>12)d=12; printf \"%.1f\", d}"); ffmpeg -y -threads 1 -f lavfi -i anullsrc=r=44100:cl=mono -t $SD -c:a libmp3lame -b:a 128k "$OUT" 2>/dev/null && echo TTS_SILENT_OK; fi; rm -f "$TXTFILE" /tmp/edge_err_${IDX}.log'''
r = subprocess.run(script, shell=True, executable='/bin/bash')
sys.exit(r.returncode)
